question: Which among the following are commonly known as blood thinners?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anticoagulants.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blood thinners** are medications that help **prevent blood clots** from forming or getting larger.
 
• **Anticoagulants** are commonly known as **blood thinners **and are used to** treat and prevent blood clots.**
 
• **Antibiotics** are medications that are used to** treat bacterial infections.**
 
• **Anticaking** agents are substances that are added to powdered or granulated materials to **prevent clumping.**
 
• **Antibodies** are** proteins** produced by the immune system to help fight off** infections and diseases.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anticoagulants** work by interfering with the** chemical reactions i**n the body that cause blood clots to form.
 
• **Antibiotics** work by **killing or stopping **the growth of bacteria.
 
• **Anticaking** agents are commonly used in food processing to** prevent powdered or granulated materials** from clumping together.
 
• **Antibodies **are produced by **white blood cells **and are used by the immune system to **identify and neutralize harmful pathogens.**
